method: After the probe page finished, getExtension and getSupportedExtensions were wrapped on both WebGL prototypes from the browser's script console, then a second cosmos.gl 3.5.1 graph (5,000 points, 10,000 links, the probe's settings) was created on a new element and run for 4 seconds, so every call below comes from cosmos.gl and luma.gl, not from the probe's own checks.
note: A request is not a requirement: luma.gl probes most of these for its feature table. cosmos.gl's README (3.5.1, Known Issues) names EXT_float_blend, for its many-body force, and OES_texture_float.
